prompt:
Task: identify the tool that is closest to your camera
Look only at the foreground tool. Ignore other object nearby. Do not guess, if you are not sure report it. If you are not able to see the top of the workbench, report "I am not able to see a workbench"
Report in the format: 
tool : [name, or "unclear"], 
visible features: [shape, material, color, part that you can see], 
confidence level" [high, medium, low]
